title: 第243章 昆吾大道反天俱乐部成立第242章 杨易合道多宝道人布置佛道
slug: 杨戬你爹从朝歌城考编回来了
content_zh:
第243章昆吾大道，反天俱乐部成立
东华大帝一边骂一边在手舞足蹈，想他身为堂堂东华大帝，自诩一生如履薄冰，什么大因果从来不干涉。
如果说西王母是低调至极，那么他便是低调至尊，自从认识这杨易之后，他便从来没有落得什么好处，连唯一的弟子都被他顺走了。
想到这里，东华大帝心中止不住一阵悲哀。
看了一眼这不见天日的深渊，东华大帝正在寻找出路，不过也料想这杨易将其丢到这不周山下应该不是没有原因的。
“不会碧游也就在这不周山底下吧。”
东华大帝嘴角微微一抽，果然感受到了一缕碧游的气息，顿时一股无名火冲上了天灵盖！！
好一个杨易，竟然连我那可怜的弟子都不放过，简直是岂有此理。
等我出了这不周山，本座必杀尽九天，屠尽天地，为我那可怜的弟子报仇！！
就在东华大帝做着心理建设的时候，陡然之间东华大帝目光一凝，只感觉无端有一股煞气将其牢牢锁定。
只见那黑暗之中，一尊宛如铁塔一般的身躯将其牢牢锁定，东华大帝元神一颤，瞬间便看清楚那来人的路数。
“刑天，大巫刑天！！！”
“当年尔被天帝断首，不是彻底被封印了吗？”
“难不成是你杀了我弟子？！”
东华大帝抬手一动，只见那东华帝剑祭出，朝着刑天杀了过去。
刑天手中干戚祭出，干便是一方青铜大盾，此物并无不是法宝，却坚不可摧，牢不可破，而那戚则是一方大斧，此斧势大力沉，势不可挡。
两人在这不周山底下杀的是天崩地暗，日月掩光，东华大帝心中悲切，一时间是吼声连连。
躲在暗处，却见一个身影兜着手，正在那里看着。
“这不周山下果然藏着一大堆疯子，我不过带着刑天大叔出来散散心，就遇到这么一个叽里呱啦的疯道人。”
这身影正是借着祖巫源血脱胎换质的哪吒，此刻修为竟已臻入了大罗金仙后期，而且一身巫力不可丈量。

尤其是那先天神火大道，竟在眉心之中孕育出了一枚都天神印。
哪吒兜着手回到了石室之内，却见碧游与苏绫儿也已经结束了调息。
碧游得了共工大神传的神水大道，还有共工大神的一部分法力，此刻修为竟堪破了准圣的层次，达到了准圣初期。
而苏绫儿如今修为竟也达到了太乙金仙中期，而且眉心之中出现了一个神秘至极的印记。
哪吒笑道：“苏绫儿，别练了，小爷我带你去看野猴子去，在外面有一个野猴子正在那里疯狂的叫嚷，被刑天大叔揍得是哭爹喊娘。”
苏绫儿俏生生的看了一眼，道：“哪吒大哥说看啥，就去看啥。”
两人并肩走在了一起，朝着石室外遁去，
哪吒与刑天意志相连，加上这不周山下煞气弥漫，东华大帝的法力最少被压制了五成，此刻完全被刑天按在地上摩擦。
一身骚包帝袍早已经撕成了碎片，而且哪吒专门对着东华大帝的屁股打，这一下将东华大帝打得是龇牙咧嘴，狼狈不堪。
“哈哈哈太逗了，这厮的屁股还真是禁打!”
听到哪吒这么一说，苏绫儿眉头微微一皱，道：“这个野猴子怎么看着有一些熟悉。”
苏绫儿眼底闪过一道灵光，道：“哪吒，别打了，别让刑天大叔打了，再打下去就打坏了！”
哪吒不以为意的笑道：“打坏了又如何，这孽畜鬼鬼祟祟，一看就不是什么好人。”
“完了完了，这不是什么孽畜，这是人家碧游仙子的师父东华大帝......”
苏绫儿捂着脸，急忙捻了一道遁光回去。
content_en:
Chapter 243 Kunwu Avenue, the Anti-Tian Club is established
Emperor Donghua was scolding and dancing at the same time, thinking that as the majestic Emperor Donghua, he prided himself on walking on thin ice throughout his life and never interfered with any major cause and effect.
If the Queen Mother of the West is extremely low-key, then he is the most low-key person. Ever since he met Yang Yi, he has never been in any good situation. Even his only disciple was taken away by him.
Thinking of this, Emperor Donghua couldn't help feeling sad.
After taking a look at the abyss that never saw the sun, Emperor Donghua was looking for a way out, but he also expected that there was a reason why Yang Yi threw him at the foot of Buzhou Mountain.
"If you don't know Biyou, you can just stay at the foot of Buzhou Mountain."
The corner of Emperor Donghua's mouth twitched slightly, and indeed he felt a wisp of Biyou's aura, and an unknown fire suddenly rushed up to the Tianling Gai! !
What a Yang Yi, he didn't even let go of my poor disciple. It's simply unreasonable.
When I leave this Buzhou Mountain, I will kill all the nine heavens and the whole world to avenge my poor disciple! !
Just when Emperor Donghua was doing some mental construction, Emperor Donghua's eyes suddenly focused, and he felt that there was an evil spirit locking him tightly for no reason.
In the darkness, he saw a body like an iron tower locking him tightly. Emperor Donghua's soul trembled, and he could instantly see clearly the direction of the coming person.
"Xingtian, the great witch Xingtian!!!"
"When you were beheaded by the Emperor of Heaven, weren't you completely sealed?"
"Could it be that you killed my disciple?!"
Emperor Donghua raised his hand and saw the Emperor Donghua sword coming out and killing Xingtian.
Xing Tian held out Gan Qi in his hand. Qian was a large bronze shield. This object was not a magic weapon, but it was indestructible and unbreakable. The Qi was a large axe. This ax was powerful and unstoppable.
The two people were killing each other under the Buzhou Mountain. The sky collapsed and the earth was dark. The sun and the moon covered the light. Emperor Donghua felt so sad that he roared for a while.
Hiding in the dark, I saw a figure with his hands clasped in his hands, watching there.
"There are indeed a lot of lunatics hiding under Buzhou Mountain. I just took Uncle Xingtian out to relax, and I met such a crazy Taoist who was gibbering."
This figure is none other than Nezha, who was reborn through the blood of the ancestral witch. At this moment, his cultivation has reached the late stage of Daluo Jinxian, and his witchcraft power is immeasurable.
Especially the innate divine fire avenue actually gave birth to a Dutian Divine Seal between the eyebrows.
Nezha Dou returned to the stone room and saw that Biyou and Su Ling'er had also finished adjusting their breath.
Biyou has obtained the Divine Water Avenue passed down by the Great God Gonggong, as well as part of the magic power of the Great God Gonggong. At this moment, his cultivation level has actually broken through the quasi-sage level, reaching the early stage of the quasi-sage.
Su Ling'er's cultivation has now reached the middle stage of Taiyi Golden Immortal, and a mysterious mark appears between her eyebrows.
Nezha smiled and said: "Su Ling'er, stop practicing. I will take you to see the wild monkeys. There is a wild monkey outside who is yelling crazily. He was beaten by Uncle Xingtian until he cried for his father and mother."
Su Ling'er took a cute look and said, "Whatever Brother Nezha says, I'll go and see it."
The two walked side by side and escaped towards the stone room.
Nezha was connected to Xingtian's will, and with the evil aura permeating Buzhou Mountain, Emperor Donghua's magic power was suppressed by at least 50%. At this moment, Xingtian was completely pressing him to the ground and rubbing him.
The slutty imperial robe had already been torn into pieces, and Nezha specifically spanked Emperor Donghua on the buttocks. This time, Emperor Donghua grinned and became embarrassed.
"Hahaha, that's so funny. This guy's butt is really forbidden to be spanked!"
Hearing what Nezha said, Su Ling'er frowned slightly and said, "Why does this wild monkey look familiar?"
A flash of light flashed in Su Ling'er's eyes, and she said: "Nezha, don't hit me. Don't let Uncle Xingtian hit you. If you keep hitting me, it will break!"
Nezha smiled nonchalantly and said, "It's broken.So what, this evil beast is so sneaky that he is not a good person at first glance. "
"It's over, it's over, this is not some evil beast, this is Fairy Biyou's master, Emperor Donghua..."
Su Ling'er covered her face and hurriedly turned back with a flash of light.
